content: HOTUBAA TO AAHIRINA ZAMANI
PASALA 24-25
Baitulla Bheatopahancuru
Kasiimpo Isa alimba minaaka i Baitulla tee alingka minaaka iwe sumai. Tangasaana Isa alingka, manga murina aumbamo tee asusuakea manga bangunana Baitulla.

Apogaumo Isa i manga incia, "Ukamatea bhari-bharia sumai? Satotuuna Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, inda dhaangia moomini saangu bhatu uka bheatosuncu i bhawona bhatu mosagaanana; bhari-bharia bheatopahancuru."
Bhaa-bhaana Kanarakaa

Wakutuuna Isa akatoro-toro samia-miana i bhawona Gunu Zaitun, aumbamo manga murina to apogau tee Incia, "Manga paumbaaka tee ingkami, naepia o kajadia incia sumai bheamembali tee opea o tanda-tandana umbaamu tee aahirina zamani?"
Isa alawanimo, "Pengkanaaka ara dhaangia tee mia mopasaladhalakomiu.
Sababuna abhari o mia bhemoumbana tee apake saroku tee apogau, 'Iakumo o Al Masi!' Manga incia bheapasaladhala mia bhari.
Ingkomiu bheurango suarana potimbea tee lelena manga mia mopotimbe, maka bholi umaeka roonamo bhari-bharia sumai tabeana amembali porikana, maka wakutuu incia sumai mencuanapo eona kiaamati.
Saangu lipu bheapobhali tee lipu mosagaanana, tee saangu pamarinta bheapobhali tee pamarinta mosagaanana. Iapai-iapai bheadhaangia tee kaara tee o alamu sii akolendu,
maka bhari-bharia sumai siimpo auwalina, mboomo kapiina inamisina bhawine wakutuuna apalaahiri anaana.
Wakutuu incia sumai, ingkomiu bheutopasaraakaaka to utosikisaa tee utopekamate. Bhari-bharia lipu bheabancikomiu roonamo uose Iaku.
Tee abhari o mia inda momatangkana iimanina roonamo opea momembalina sumai, tee manga incia apopasaraakaaka tee apobanci-banci podho-podho manga incia.
Abhari o nabii gau-gau bheaumba to apasaladhala manga mia bhari.
Roonamo kadhaki ahandamo kabharina sumaimo kaasina mia bhari amembali amatawaa.
Maka o mia mopotaangina sakawana kapadhaana bheatopasalaamati.
Tee Lele Malape Pamarintana Aulataʼala bheapakolelea i saangua dunia sii, mamudhaakana bhari-bharia lipu arangoa. Sapadhana incia sumai, kasiimpo bheaumba o eona kiaamati."
Kasikisaa Momatamo tee Manga Nabii Gau-gau
"Ingkomiu bheukamata 'Giu Monaajisina tee Mopahancuruna' akakaro i tampa momangkilo, mboomo ipogauakana Nabii Daniel, -- manga mobacana tabeana akamata opea o maʼanana!
Kasiimpo manga mia i Yudea tabeana apalai i gunu mamudhaakana atopasalaamati.
Manga mia modhaangiana i bhawona padhana bhanua bholi asapo to aala manga pewauana i nuncana bhanuana, maka tabeana alausakamo apalai!
Tee manga mia motangasaana i inawuna bholi ambuli to aala manga pakeana, maka tabeana alausakamo apalai!
Acilakamo manga bhawine motangasaana mobhawa-bhawa atawa mopaduduna anana i zamani naile itu!
Udoʼamo mamudhaakana wakutuuna upalaiaka karomiu inda akawa wakutuuna kagari atawa o eona Saputuu.
Roonamo wakutuu incia sumai bheamembali o kasukara momaoge tee indapo mina adhaangia minaaka i bhaa-bhaana dunia sakawana sii-sii, tee indamo bheamembali pendua.
Ande o wakutuu incia sumai inda atopekadhei, sumaimo inda dhaangia samia uka bhemosalaamatina; maka roonamo manga mia ipilina, sumaimo o Aulataʼala bheapekadheia o wakutuuna.
Wakutuu incia sumai, ande dhaangia o mia mopogauna tee ingkomiu, 'Kamatea, Al Masi dhaangia iwe sii!,' atawa 'Al Masi dhaangia iwe sumai!,' bholi uparacaea.
Roonamo bheaumba al masi gau-gau tee manga nabii gau-gau, manga incia bheapadhaangia giu inda momentela tee manga muuzizati, mamudhaakana (ande amembali) apasaladhala manga mia ipilina uka.
Jadi, udhania! Padhamo kupaumbakomiu porikana minaaka i piamo itu, wakutuu kajadia incia sii indapo amembali.
Jadi ande dhaangia o mia mopogauna tee ingkomiu, 'Kamatea, Incia dhaangia i tana matuu,' bholi ulingka iwe sumai; atawa, 'Kamatea, Incia dhaangia i nuncana kamara,' bholi uparacaea!
Sababuna ande aumba o Anana Maanusia bheakocahea mboomo bhibhito akokila minaaka i timbu sakawana i bhara.
Iapai dhaangia tee bhangke, iwe siitu dhaangia tee manu-manu bunia aporomu-romu."
Umbaana Anana Maanusia
"Inda mangenge sapadhana kasukara incia sumai, matanaeo bheamalalanda tee o bula indamo akocahea tee kalipopo bheakotibu minaaka i laiana tee manga mokuasaina laiana bheabagoeamo.

Kasiimpo bheatokamatamo o tanda Anana Maanusia i laiana. Bhari-bharia manga lipu i dunia sii sumbere bheatangi amaporo tee manga incia bheakamata Anana Maanusia aumba i bhawona taʼina ngalu tee kuasana tee kamuliana momaoge.

Incia bheatumpu manga malaaʼekatina alimba tee atowii sangkakalana tee suara momakaa tee bhearomusaka manga mia ipilina minaaka i pata singkua dunia, minaaka i tapana laiana sakawana i tapana laiana mosagaanana.
Aalea o kaadhari minaaka i ibaratina puuna ara. Ande manga rahana amalulu wakutuuna apepuumo akotuna, umatauamea ande bheakawamo bulaana paneeo.
Mboo sumai uka, ande ukamata bhari-bharia giu incia sumai amembali, siitumo umataua wakutuuna amakasumo mpuu.
Satotuuna Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, manga mia i zamani sii-sii indapo amate bhari-bharia ande o giu incia sumai indapo amembali.
Laiana tee alamu sii bheaila, maka o pogauku sii inda bheaila saʼumurua.
Inda dhaangia samia uka momataua naepia o eona tee jamuna, manga malaaʼekati i sorogaa inda amataua uka, Anana Maanusia uka inda amataua, maka tangkanamo o Amaku samia momataua."
Kaadhari Mamudhaakana Akojaga-jaga
"Wakutuuna umbaana Anana Maanusia naile itu, kadhaangiana mboomo zamanina Nabii Nuh i piamo itu.
Roonamo zamani i piamo itu wakutuuna indapo aumba uwena mawa sumai, manga mia akande tee asumpu, akawi tee atopakawi mboo sumai torotorosu sakawana o eona Nabii Nuh apesua i nuncana bhangka maogena.
Tee manga incia inda amatau opeopea, kasiimpo uwena mawa sumai aumba tee apatondu manga incia bhari-bharia, mboo sumai uka naile itu wakutuuna umbaana Anana Maanusia.
Wakutuu incia sumai, dhaangia rua mia o mia tangasaana akarajaa i inawuna; samia bheatoangka tee samiana bheatobholi.
Rua mia bhawine tangasaana apatii kagilina gandumna; samia bheatoangka tee samiana bheatobholi.
Jadi ukojaga-jagamo sababuna ingkomiu inda umataua naepia o Kawasana Opumu bheaumba.
Maka udhania o giu incia sii! Ande mokobhanuana amataua rambi saopea o mia manako bheaumba, atantumo incia bheakojaga-jaga mamudhaakana o mia manako sumai inda apesua i nuncana bhanuana.
Rampaakanamo sumai, ingkomiu tabeana umakanumo roonamo Anana Maanusia bheaumba wakutuuna inda unamu-namua."
Ibaratina to Bhatua Motaʼati tee Bhatua Momadhaki
"Incema o bhatua motaʼati tee incema o bhatua moʼaarifu? Siitumo iangkana opuna to amembali kapalana manga bhatuana, modhawuna kinande i manga bhatua mosagaanana ande akawa wakutuuna.
Amasanaa mpuu o bhatua bheapotibhaakea tangasaana apewau karajaana i wakutuuna opuna aumba.
Satotuuna Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu: Opuna sumai bheapamembalia mojaganina bhari-bharia pewauana.
Maka ande bhatua sumai amadhaki tee apogau i nuncana ngangarandana,
'Opuku dhaangia amangenge ambuli,' kasiimpo incia apepuumo abhebhe bhari-bharia bhatua mosagaanana, tee akande asumpu apobhawa-bhawa tee manga momalangona,
sanampuu opuna sumai ambuli i eo inda inamu-namuna tee i wakutuu inda imatauna.
Kasiimpo opuna asikisaaia tee adhikaia apapoosea tee manga mia munaafiki. Iwe sumai dhaangia tangi momaporo mpuu tee mopakiri-kirina ngincina."
